firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently climbed a tower starts.
clarifications: That player receives the Caliph’s patronage tile and starts with 20 Asari. Each successive player clockwise begins with one more Asari than the previous player.
The starting player takes the first turn; turns then proceed clockwise.

Tower sections, buyers and Caliph’s patronage match inventory BGG 72991. SHA-256: 39f5372d13332ae6e056200a3379019b82b4b1c5ccb30222056f34dbd664ff98. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. uncertainty: The rules do not specify what counts as climbing a tower or how to break a tie.
